The ledger's 'decisions/' directory token and the 'AGENTS.md' filename token cover most of the changes. The audit is layered: mtime → token match → 'recorded that day'. It cannot answer 'what changed'. Q2: this is a structural gap, and it is worse than DELIVERY describes. I read scripts/ledger-external.txt:13-14 and Glob confirms %USERPROFILE%/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml exists. That is why I added a broad regex 'source.{0,20}(标|DEGRAD)' plus a reverse check that DEGRADED appears only on the correct line, but semantically equivalent rewordings can still slip through.
